reviews.title: The advertising on TikTok has become excessive, and I genuinely think the platform needs to reconsid
reviews.text:
It feels like every two or three scrolls you’re coming across another sponsored advert. There is a difference between incorporating advertising into a platform and overwhelming the user experience with it. TikTok is increasingly crossing that line.

What’s particularly frustrating is that I question how effective this level of advertising actually is for the companies paying to appear on the platform. People are becoming so accustomed to seeing constant adverts that they’ve developed the habit of immediately scrolling past them. They’re not engaging, they’re not interested and they’re certainly not necessarily forming a positive impression of the brands being advertised.

There is also the frustration of accidentally clicking on adverts while scrolling. Yes, you can scroll past them, but that doesn’t mean they aren’t disruptive. Constantly having sponsored content inserted into your feed changes the entire browsing experience.

From a psychological and marketing perspective, there is a point where repeated exposure stops being effective and starts creating irritation. Consumers become desensitised, develop advertising fatigue and can even develop negative associations with the brands repeatedly interrupting them. An accidental click does not equal genuine interest, purchasing intent or a successful advertising campaign.

السعودية أكبر من سخريتهم

السعودية ليست مجرد اسم على خريطة، بل دولة لها تاريخ عريق ومكانة عظيمة، وشعب يعتز بهويته وقيادته ووطنه.

من يستهزئ بالسعودية، فليعلم أن الأوطان لا تُقاس بالنكات ولا بالتعليقات الساخرة، بل بتاريخها وإنجازاتها ومواقفها. والسعودية بتاريخها وثقافتها وحضارتها وإنجازاتها أكبر من أن تختصرها سخرية جاهل أو تعليق عابر.

نحن لا نحتاج إلى التقليل من شأن الآخرين حتى نُظهر عظمة وطننا، ولا نحتاج إلى الدخول في مهاترات لإثبات مكانتنا. يكفينا أن نرى ما تحقق من تطور وإنجازات في مختلف المجالات، وما يقدمه أبناء الوطن من نجاحات.

السعودية عز وفخر، والانتماء لها شرف، ومن يظن أن سخريته ستقلل من قيمتها فهو لا يدرك أن قيمة الوطن لا يحددها رأي الآخرين.

دام عزك يا وطن. 🇸🇦

I want Apple to review these concerns about TikTok and its unfair content moderation. Users deserve transparency, consistent rules, and the right to appeal decisions that make no sense.

reviews.title: Please grow a backbone
reviews.text:
[This is my opinion]

Every person who is at least a little bit conscious knows full well that every single choice made by you the developers of this app is for money and not for creating something good. This is my genuine experience of using TikTok, and I’m writing this review based on that experience. There are constant ads, sponsorships, increasing changes to the algorithm to make it more sensitive (don’t think I can’t feel it), and many many features no one wants or asked for. It’s all honed to catch and keep attention with no regard for wellbeing. That’s what makes the time limit feature (and those “time to take a break 😌” ads) so annoying. No, I do not want to take a deep breath. Yes, I am abandoning my mission. I don’t remember deciding on a mission. There’s something particularly gross about having stuff that’s wearing the skin of something helpful being done to you instead.

It’s sinister, but it is also embarrassing to me because it’s constant bending to the whims of sponsors. Is the time limit thing because of a law? Bending to that as well, in the least honest way possible.

reviews.title: Proved My Age, Still Punished
reviews.text:
I’m beyond disappointed with TikTok’s handling of my account. My account was removed for being underage, even though I submitted my ID and clearly proved that I am over 16. While they did technically restore my account, it’s basically unusable now.
All of my videos were taken down and set to “only me,” and I have no option to make them public again. On top of that, I can’t post new content, can’t set a profile picture, and can’t properly use any of the main features. It feels like my account is stuck in a restricted state with no explanation or way to fix it.
I’ve tried everything to resolve this. I contacted the Help Centre, but they just kept telling me to “appeal” — even though I already did that, which is how I got my account back in the first place. There’s no option to appeal again, and no real support to actually fix the problem.
At this point, my account is basically useless. What’s the point of restoring it if I can’t use it? This whole process has been unfair, confusing, and incredibly frustrating. TikTok seriously needs to fix their support system and how they handle situations like this.

reviews.text:
I’m really disappointed with TikTok lately. There is a huge amount of sexualized content in the app — women in revealing outfits, including content that clearly focuses on body parts.
What’s frustrating is that when I report this kind of content, TikTok often responds that no violation was found. It makes the reporting system feel pointless.
Also, when I try to “help improve recommendations” by selecting that I’m not interested in this type of content, nothing actually changes. I keep seeing the same things over and over again.
Moreover, this kind of content should not be there in the first place, especially since minors use the app, and it does not have a positive influence on them.
I would really appreciate it if TikTok took user feedback more seriously and made their moderation and recommendation system more effective.
